# 周易章句證異

**ID:** KR1a0162
**Custom ID:** ZB1a0159
**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V53.3, p671
**Extent:** 12 卷

## Authors / Editors
- 翟圴廉 (清朝) 撰

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A focused philological *Yìjīng* work in twelve juàn by [翟均廉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BF%9F%E5%9D%87%E5%BB%89) Zhái Jūnlián of Rénhé 仁和 (Hángzhōu), Grand Secretariat Drafter, completed in 1765 (per catalog meta). The work systematically compares the canonical-text recensions and chapter-and-phrase-divisions of the various Hàn-and-Sòng commentators on the upper-and-lower scriptures of the *Zhōuyì*. Two distinct types of variant are treated:

(1) **Structural variants** (chapter-and-section orderings): [李鼎祚](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E9%BC%8E%E7%A5%9A) Lǐ Dǐngzuò prefixes the *Xùguà* 序卦 before each hexagram-statement; [周燔](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%91%A8%E7%87%94) Zhōu Fán lays out *Dà xiàng* 大象 before the hexagram-statement, with *Tuàn zhuàn* 彖傳 below; [趙汝楳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%B6%99%E6%B1%9D%E6%A5%B3) Zhào Rǔméi prefixes *Dà xiàng* before the hexagram-statement, with *Tuàn zhuàn* below it, then *Wényán*, then line-statements; [李過](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E9%81%8E) Lǐ Guò and [方逢辰](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%B9%E9%80%A2%E8%BE%B0) Fāng Féngchén lay out *Tuàn zhuàn* below the hexagram-statement, then *Wényán*, then *Tuàn*-explication, then *Dà xiàng*, then line-statements; [蔡淵](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%94%A1%E6%B7%B5) Cài Yuán lays out *Dà xiàng* below the hexagram-statement, then *Tuàn zhuàn*; *Wényán* separately as one *zhuàn* indented one space; [王洙](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E6%B4%99) Wáng Zhū does not include the hexagram-statements in the canonical text but as a separate chapter — and so on.

(2) **Textual-phrase variants** (line-readings): on *Qián* 9/3, [孟喜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AD%9F%E5%96%9C) Mèng Xǐ reads "*xī tì ruò yín*" 夕惕若夤 (period) "*lì wú jiù*" 厲无咎 (period); [荀爽](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8D%80%E7%88%BD) Xún Shuǎng, [虞翻](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%99%9E%E7%BF%BB) Yú Fān, [王弼](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%8B%E5%BC%BC) Wáng Bì read "*xī tì ruò lì*" 夕惕若厲 (period); [邵雍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%82%B5%E9%9B%8D) Shào Yōng, [朱震](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%B1%E9%9C%87) Zhū Zhèn, [朱熹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%B1%E7%86%B9) Zhū Xī read "*xī tì ruò*" 夕惕若 (period). Such variants are catalogued line-by-line through all sixty-four hexagrams; Zhái occasionally interpolates his own opinions, marked *Lián àn* 廉案.

The *Sìkù* editors describe the work as "quite refined-and-tight" (頗為精密) in its philological apparatus and prefer it to [郭京](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%83%AD%E4%BA%AC) Guō Jīng's Táng-period *Zhōuyì jǔ zhèng* 周易舉正 — the principal medieval parallel — because Guō altered the canonical text by conjecture (attributing the alterations to a fictitious Wáng Bì / [韓伯](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9F%93%E4%BC%AF) Hán Bó old recension) while Zhái's variants are all grounded in actual transmitted commentary recensions.

**Abstract**

Composition is fixed by the catalog meta to 1765; the bracket here adopts the single year. The work is a substantively important mid-Qiánlóng philological monograph on the *Yì*'s textual recensions and chapter-divisions.

The work is one of the most thorough Qing philological apparatuses on the *Yì*-canon's textual variants, and represents the *kǎozhèng* school's mature focused application to canonical-text criticism. Its dual focus on structural variants (chapter-and-section orderings) and textual-phrase variants (line-readings) gives it broader coverage than most parallel works (Wáng Yīngtīng's Sòng-period *Zhōuyì jīng zhuàn yīn xùn* 周易經傳音訓, etc.). The *Sìkù* editors' favorable comparison to Guō Jīng's *Jǔ zhèng* is methodologically substantive: Guō had been one of the principal pre-Qing philological treatments of the *Yì*-canon's variants but had been long suspected of conjectural-attribution; Zhái's evidence-based work supersedes Guō.

The work is therefore one of the principal *kǎozhèng*-era *Yì*-textual-criticism monographs, alongside [毛奇齡](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AF%9B%E5%A5%87%E9%BD%A1) Máo Qílíng's *Zhòngshì Yì* 仲氏易 ([KR1a0126](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0126)) for the methodological side and [胡渭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%83%A1%E6%B8%AD) Hú Wèi's *Yìtú míng biàn* ([KR1a0138](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1a/KR1a0138)) for the chart-tradition critique. Together they constitute the canonical Qing *kǎozhèng* corpus on the *Yì*.
